title: Engine swing visuals: clip per animation, real-time first-person view model, trail in the strike window
player_outcome: Swings and mining look smooth at any frame rate. The third-person arm plays each swing once to the end, the first-person tool eases up, strikes and settles instead of snapping, and the white arc appears exactly when the blade comes down.
design: PlayerAvatar.Motion: start the action when entity.UseSerial != _lastSerial via h.Play(ActionFor(...), entity.UseAnimationMax / 60f, timing). Drop the UseAnimation-jump detection (_lastUse). The ChooseClip fallback keeps UseAnimation > 0.
HumanoidAnimator.BuildTree: insert an AnimationNodeTimeSeek 'act_seek' between act_speed and pick.

HumanoidAnimator.Play(action, seconds, float maxRate, float windupEnd): rate = clip.Length / seconds. If rate > maxRate, use rate = maxRate and seek_request = windupEnd * clip.Length, so very fast weapons skip the wind-up and the strike still lands inside the use. Otherwise seek 0. _actionLeft = seconds.
ViewModel: phase t = Clamp((UseAnimationMax - UseAnimation + Engine.GetPhysicsInterpolationFraction()) / UseAnimationMax, 0, 1), which is sub-tick and real time.
ViewModel melee/tool pose: raised over the shoulder until windupEnd, strike driven by Timing.Sweep ("swing" for weapons, "mine" for tools), then follow-through.

ViewModel easing: an engage weight eases in (0.06 s) and out (0.15 s) with SmoothStep blending from Rest, so the model never snaps rest->raised in one frame. On a UseSerial change, crossfade from the last pose over 0.05 s (autoswing chains). Thrust uses the Striking window.

SwingTrail: Duration = entity.UseAnimationMax / 60; head = HalfArc - Sweep * 2 * HalfArc; nothing drawn before windupEnd; Reach multiplied by Prefixes.Size(held stack) so the trail matches the hitbox.
SwingTrail colour: Color.FromHtml(info.Swing.TrailColor) when set, else today's white/rarity mix (MeleeSwingParams.TrailColor is finally read).
docs/architecture/rendering.md: character animation paragraph (no restarts, seek cap).
